    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierOrderToSplit" sourceRef="Task_GiveSommelierOrder" targetRef="Gateway_SommelierAndWaiterSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierSplitToAlcohol" sourceRef="Gateway_SommelierAndWaiterSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholOrdered" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderIncludesWineOrOtherAlcoholicBeverage</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholNotOrdered" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholPrepared" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholMergeToPreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierSplitToAssignment" sourceRef="Gateway_SommelierAndWaiterSplit" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignmentToWaiterPreparation" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterSplitToCart" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterSplitToNonalcoholicDrinks" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CartToWaiterJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NonalcoholicDrinksToWaiterJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterJoinToPreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoinToOrderJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_OrderPreparationJoin"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/evanstonian/room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service call"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hotel" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service call" sourceRef="Task_GuestCalls" targetRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Call room service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestCalls" name="Guest calls room service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CallPlaced" name="Call placed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuestStartToCall" sourceRef="StartEvent_Guest" targetRef="Task_GuestCalls"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuestCallToEnd" sourceRef="Task_GuestCalls" targetRef="EndEvent_CallPlaced"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Handle room-service order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_KitchenAndHandoffSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GiveSommelierOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SommelierAndWaiterSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderPreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingTimingDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PostponeBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingTimingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderBilled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service call received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Room-service manager takes down the order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Room-service manager submits the order ticket to the kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_KitchenAndHandoffSplit" name="Kitchen preparation and further handoff begin"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Kitchen prepares the food"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveSommelierOrder" name="Room-service manager gives the order to the sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_SommelierAndWaiterSplit" name="Sommelier and waiter work concurrently"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholDecision" name="Order includes wine or other alcoholic beverages?" default="Flow_NoAlcohol">
      <bpmn:documentation>Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or some other alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" name="Sommelier fetches wine from the cellar and prepares other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" name="Merge alcoholic-beverage paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Room-service manager assigns the order to the waiter"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" name="Waiter prepares cart and nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Waiter readies the cart with a tablecloth and silverware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Waiter prepares nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" name="Cart and nonalcoholic drinks ready"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderPreparationJoin" name="Food, beverages, and cart ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Waiter delivers the order to the guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Waiter returns to the room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingTimingDecision" name="Waiter postpones billing for another order?" default="Flow_BillNow"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostponeBilling" name="Waiter postpones billing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingTimingMerge" name="Merge billing paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitAccount" name="Waiter debits the guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderBilled" name="Guest account debited"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CallToTakeOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeOrderToTicket" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TicketToKitchenAndHandoff" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Gateway_KitchenAndHandoffSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToKitchen" sourceRef="Gateway_KitchenAndHandoffSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_KitchenToOrderJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_OrderPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToSommelierOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_KitchenAndHandoffSplit" targetRef="Task_GiveSommelierOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierOrderToSplit" sourceRef="Task_GiveSommelierOrder" targetRef="Gateway_SommelierAndWaiterSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierSplitToAlcoholDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_SommelierAndWaiterSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholOrdered" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderIncludesAlcoholicBeverage = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholPrepared" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholMergeToOrderJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OrderPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SommelierSplitToAssignment" sourceRef="Gateway_SommelierAndWaiterSplit" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignmentToWaiterPreparation" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterSplitToCart" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterSplitToNonalcoholicDrinks" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CartToWaiterJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinksToWaiterJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterJoinToOrderJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_OrderPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderJoinToDelivery" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderPreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryToReturn" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnToBillingDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingTimingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostponeBilling" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingTimingDecision" targetRef="Task_PostponeBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">waiterHasAnotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillNow" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingTimingDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BillingTimingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostponementToBillingMerge" sourceRef="Task_PostponeBilling" targetRef="Gateway_BillingTimingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingMergeToDebit" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingTimingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DebitToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DebitAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderBilled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that an activity is followed by a decision, synchronization, or cycle-exit condition, or that concurrent work begins after a preceding activity: Connect the activity to the relevant gateway with a sequence flow; for concurrent work, route the preceding flow through a parallel gateway that starts the concurrent branches.
rules.situation: the description states that work on multiple activities proceeds concurrently after a preceding activity

rules.instruction: When the description says an activity may be postponed because the participant has competing work: Model and label the delay as postponing the stated activity; do not describe it as performing the competing work.
rules.situation: the description says an activity may be postponed because the participant has competing work

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly identifies the role or participant responsible for an activity: Include that responsible role or participant in the BPMN activity label when needed to preserve who performs the work.
rules.situation: the description explicitly identifies the role or participant responsible for an activity

rules.instruction: When the description states that an external participant performs an action that initiates work by another participant: Model the action as a task in the external participant’s process and connect it to the receiving participant’s process with a message flow.
rules.situation: the description states that an external participant performs an action that initiates work by another participant

rules.instruction: Use short, faithful labels in the input language. Prefer verb-object activity names and meaningful business triggers or outcomes for events.
rules.situation: the description states a specific business outcome that completes the process
